name: risk-register
description: Create and maintain a persistent risk register. Each risk has ID, statement, category, owner, likelihood, impact, score/level, response strategy, current controls, residual risk, review cadence, status, and history. Supports ingesting risks from risk-matrix, fmea, monte-carlo-simulation, and pre-mortem. Exports to Markdown and CSV. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
